title: Dungeons And Villages: Deeper and Darker
description: Adds dungeons to the Deeper and Darker dimension
body:
Adds 2 new dungeons to the Deeper and Darker mod dimension.

![structures from the mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d43b4ca9ba3c564fbf4b40c79f2d28efdc69c237.jpeg)
____________________________________________________________________________________
### [All projects in the Dungeons and Villages series](https://modrinth.com/collection/J24mVlTf)

____________________________________________________________________________________
This addon adds 2 dungeons to Otherside dimensions
- More than 50 rooms to explore
- The mini boss
- treasure trove
- custom loot tables
____________________________________________________________________________________
### Roadmap:

```
Full v2.0.x Deeper and Darker support
```
